item.cookies_candy_and_cakes.apple_cooki: A crispy cookie with fresh apples. But something feels... wrong about it.
A crispy cookie with fresh apples. They say an apple a day keeps additional troubles away...
A crispy cookie with fresh apples. Simply delicious!
item.cookies_candy_and_cakes.carrot_cook: A healthy cookie with carrots. But the shadows seem to follow you...
A healthy treat, perfect for long nights. Rabbits seem to never miss a thing.
A healthy cookie with carrots. Tastes wonderful!
item.cookies_candy_and_cakes.glow_berry_: A luminous delicacy from the depths. The light flickers ominously...

A luminous delicacy from the depths. Irresistible!
item.cookies_candy_and_cakes.melon_cooki: Juicy and refreshing! But there's a strange taste of misfortune...
Juicy and refreshing! The natural sweetness seems to bring life back into weary bodies.
item.cookies_candy_and_cakes.pumpkin_coo: Sturdy and hearty. The jack-o'-lantern seems to be grinning at you...

Sturdy and hearty. Perfect for autumn days!
item.cookies_candy_and_cakes.slime_sugar: Too much slime sugar, you can't move!
You feel bouncy... and a bit slimy.
item.cookies_candy_and_cakes.sweet_berry: Wild berries in crispy dough. But they taste of dark omens...
These wild berries make foxes particularly nimble and... bouncy!
Wild berries in crispy dough. Simply delicious!
item.cookies_candy_and_cakes.unidentifie: A sinister cookie with an ominous aura. You need to taste it to reveal its dark secrets...
